youtube_title: The steamer Chicora, 1895: the warning that came too late
body: The warning came too late. On January 21, 1895, the steamer Chicora left Milwaukee before dawn, bound for her home port, St. Joseph, Michigan. Her owner sent a warning not to sail, but she was already gone. That day, a gale and a blizzard tore across Lake Michigan. The Chicora never made port. Everyone aboard, about two dozen people, was lost. Wreckage washed up between South Haven and Saugatuck, and near St. Joseph, a little terrier known to have been aboard came ashore alive. The Chicora has never been found. Comment your town for the next La Porte After Dark. #LakeMichigan #StJoseph #Shipwreck #GreatLakes #History #LaPorteAfterDark
